description.zh: 把流程描述、制度文档或代码逻辑画成流程图、泳道图、时序图、状态图、思维导图和甘特图；支持语法校验，导出 PNG / SVG / PDF，并能生成可在 draw.io 中继续编辑的文件。
description.en: Turns process descriptions, policies, or code logic into flowcharts, swimlanes, sequence, state, mind-map, and Gantt diagrams. Validates syntax, exports PNG / SVG / PDF, and generates editable draw.io files.

welcome_message.zh: 描述你的流程，或者把制度文档、代码发给我，我来画成图
welcome_message.en: Describe your process, or send me a policy document or code — I'll turn it into a diagram

prompt.zh: 请把下面的流程画成流程图，标出判断条件和异常处理：
prompt.en: Draw the following process as a flowchart, marking decisions and exception handling:

description.zh: 按角色分泳道，看清交接
description.en: One lane per role to show handoffs

prompt.zh: 请画一张泳道图，角色有：___。流程如下：
prompt.en: Draw a swimlane diagram. Roles: ___. The process:

description.zh: 服务、接口之间的调用顺序
description.en: Call order between services and APIs

prompt.zh: 请根据下面的接口调用说明（或代码）画一张时序图，包含成功和失败分支：
prompt.en: Draw a sequence diagram from the following API description (or code), with success and failure branches:

description.zh: 订单、工单等对象的状态变化
description.en: State changes of orders, tickets, etc.

prompt.zh: 请画出 ___ 的状态流转图，包含每个状态的触发条件：
prompt.en: Draw the state diagram for ___, including the trigger for each transition:

description.en: Break down a topic into branches

prompt.zh: 请把下面的内容整理成一张思维导图：
prompt.en: Organize the following content into a mind map:

description.zh: 生成能拖拽修改的 .drawio 文件
description.en: A .drawio file you can drag and edit

prompt.zh: 请把下面的流程做成可以在 draw.io 里编辑的文件，同时导出一张 PNG 预览：
prompt.en: Turn the following process into an editable draw.io file and export a PNG preview:

zh: 每周一「10:00」检查 inbound 目录新增的制度文档，为每份文档画出审批流程图
每个工作日「18:00」把当天会议纪要里的流程变更更新到对应的 .mmd 源文件并重新导出
每月 1 日「09:00」根据项目计划表生成本月甘特图，发给我确认
每周五「17:00」把本周新增接口整理成时序图，先发草稿
每季度第一个工作日「10:00」复核部门泳道图，列出与最新制度不一致的地方
每天「09:30」把昨天的工单状态变化整理成一张状态流转图
en: Every Monday at 10:00, check new policy documents in inbound and draw an approval flowchart for each
Every weekday at 18:00, apply process changes from today's meeting notes to the matching .mmd sources and re-export
On the 1st of each month at 09:00, build this month's Gantt chart from the project plan and send it for review
Every Friday at 17:00, turn this week's new APIs into sequence diagrams — drafts only
On the first weekday of each quarter at 10:00, review department swimlanes and list mismatches with current policy
Every day at 09:30, summarize yesterday's ticket status changes as a state diagram
